1.c4 g6 2.Nc3 Bg7 3.g3 Nf6 4.Bg2 O-O 5.e.strategy: Develops the knight to e2 instead of f3, which would block the bishop on g2. The f-pawn stays free to advance, and c3 and d4 are covered from behind. White prepares castling and a space-gaining plan with the pawn centre.
Takes control of d4 and f4 and claims space, so White cannot simply set up with d4. The centre is likely to stay closed, and both sides will manoeuvre for the d4 square and for a break on the flanks.
